metric_notes.auc_observed: trapezoidal y(0)=0, normalized by observed horizon; no tail extrapolation
metric_notes.auc_nominal_hold_last: completed runs only; hold last evaluation to nominal t_max
metric_notes.final100k: arithmetic mean of recorded evaluations in [t_max-100000, t_max]
metric_notes.calls: last periodic training counter; excludes unlogged tail, evaluation, retries and tokens
metric_notes.completion: Slurm COMPLETED/0:0 when provided; otherwise explicit Sacred COMPLETED
